title: Builder BLD-902: Owner walk-through

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-902.

detail:
BZ Hardening, pass BLD-902 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-902). Owner walk-through. Scope: staging. Build: Five owners each build a page from a blank Space while we watch. Log every hesitation and failed find. Promote any Layer 2 control used by 3 of 5 into Layer 1. Done when: Every owner publishes without help; No control is searched for in ⌘K by more than 2 owners. Gates: Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-901. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Tooling is built (2026-11-09): the observer logs one session per owner in docs/builder-walkthrough/sessions.json (shape in session.example.json) and `pnpm walkthrough:builder` prints the verdict: who published without help, any control searched for in ⌘K by more than two owners, and the Layer 2 controls used by three of five owners, which move into Layer 1 (lib/builder/walkthrough.ts). The row stays open: it closes when five real owners have been watched and the log passes. It needs the owner's choice of the five people and a staging session; an agent cannot stand in for them.
